 Live Reporting
 Most recent Most popular PENALTIES published at 21:30 GMT 21:30 GMT 
 Man City 2-2 Brighton (2-2 penalties) 
 Stroked home beautifully by Enzo Fernandez into a similar area to Phil Foden's.
 Another good penalty from Matt O'Riley, going the same way as Pascal Gross into the bottom corner.
 3 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:30 GMT 21:30 GMT 
 Liverpool 1-1 Chelsea 
 Clinton Morrison 
Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Liverpool have made these subs and have gotten worse. They haven't improved.
 This is Chelsea's spell at the moment, they need to score whilst they are on top.
 15 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 21:30 GMT 21:30 GMT 
 Liverpool 1-1 Chelsea 
 Chelsea now make a triple change as Emanuel Emegha, Valentín Barco and Marco Palestra come on for Danny Welbeck, Malo Gusto and Moisés Caicedo.
 This is the first appearance of the season for summer signing Emanuel Emegha, with debut having been delayed by injury. A chance to see what the forward can do.
 9 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PENALTIES published at 21:29 GMT 21:29 GMT 
 Man City 2-2 Brighton (1-1 penalties) 
 An emphatic penalty from Phil Foden to kick things off, slamming into the roof of the net.
 Pascal Gross stutters then fires into the bottom corner to make it one apiece.
 260 78 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:27 GMT 21:27 GMT 
 Fulham 0-1 Crystal Palace 
 Palace's substitutions have given them a bit of breathing space.
 Dwight McNeil has a chance after a promising counter-attack. He chops in and unleashes on his right foot but it's a tame effort and easily saved by Benjamin Lecomte.
 121 44 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:27 GMT 21:27 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Cheer up, Villans. At least it wasn’t Fleetwood on penalties.
 Andy (wounded Arsenal fan) 
 793 82 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:27 GMT 21:27 GMT 
 Bournemouth 3-0 Aston Villa 
 Some late pressure here from Aston Villa but it is all academic with Bournemouth holding a big lead with five minutes to go.
 157 32 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:26 GMT 21:26 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 This Chelsea performance is hard to watch. You can tell how much we miss Palmer and Pedro. Now we may lose Lacroix for a period? This is bad for us. United will be licking their lips for the next match.
 Nick 
 256 234 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:26 GMT 21:26 GMT 
 Liverpool 1-1 Chelsea 
 The attacking changes have added more bite to the Liverpool attack as Bradley Barcola is basically allowed to run towards the box unchallenged but his low strike is well saved by Mike Penders.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 238 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:25 GMT 21:25 GMT 
 FT: Man City 2-2 Brighton 
 A real test for goalkeeper Geronimo Rulli in just his second match at Manchester City.
 He had a couple of wobbly moments in that second half which doesn't bode well now.
 197 90 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:25 GMT 21:25 GMT 
 Liverpool 1-1 Chelsea 
 Clinton Morrison 
Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Ronald Araújo has to score. 
 It's straight at Penders, but I'll give the goalkeeper credit. Good reaction save.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 213 63 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 FULL-TIME published at 21:24 GMT 21:24 GMT 
 Man City 2-2 Brighton 
 That is that. We go to penalties.
 448 212 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 21:24 GMT 21:24 GMT 
 Man City 2-2 Brighton 
 Yankubah Minteh almost sends Brighton through to the last-eight with the last kick of the game! A brilliant effort but it's just rising a little too much and goes over the bar.
 151 105 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:23 GMT 21:23 GMT 
 Liverpool 1-1 Chelsea 
 Clinton Morrison 
Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Liverpool are way too open, but I must say the defending from Joe Gomez is outstanding.
 210 52 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:23 GMT 21:23 GMT 
 Man City 2-2 Brighton 
 A late free-kick for Manchester City and it's delivered superbly by Phil Foden. It requires only a touch from Enzo Fernandez but he can't get one.
 That will surely be that.
 176 84 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 21:22 GMT 21:22 GMT 
 Liverpool 1-1 Chelsea 
 Two big changes at either end!
 Ronald Araujo is picked out unmarked inside the box by a cross and sends a header at goal, but Mike Penders saves and then Chelsea counter through Morgan Rogers, who gets to the edge of the box but Joe Gomez does really well to get back and get the block in.
 161 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:22 GMT 21:22 GMT 
 Fulham 0-1 Crystal Palace 
 Fulham have had 12 shots, three on target.
 Palace have had one. It was the goal in the 37th minute. That remains their one and only shot, on target or otherwise.
 162 47 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Wingers are looking tired published at 21:21 GMT 21:21 GMT 
 Sunderland 3-1 Brentford 
 Gary Bennett 
Ex-Sunderland defender on BBC Radio Newcastle 
 One of the problems which Sunderland may have is fatigue kicking in. 
 You look at Ta Bi and Fofana, there is a bit of tiredness. 
 They might need to freshen things up. 
 130 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Handy to have Barcola and Wirtz published at 21:21 GMT 21:21 GMT 
 Liverpool 1-1 Chelsea 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter at Anfield 
 It's pretty handy when you can throw on two players that cost over £100m each and it's two players who have looked better and better in recent weeks.
 You'd fancy Liverpool from here.
 369 129 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:21 GMT 21:21 GMT 
 Liverpool 1-1 Chelsea 
 The substitutes combine early inside the box, Bradley Barcola winning the ball from Malo Gusto, who goes down really easily again, and finds Florian Wirtz, but he has his back to goal and the Chelsea defence is able to recover.
 84 24 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing
